title: The Ascending Silence

features.name: rising body
features.desc-on-touch: Where pressure becomes weight becomes time again. You rise through silence that holds you, feeling your own body as the measure of its depth. Each step up is a breath that the earth remembers.

features.name: somatic registry
features.desc-on-touch: A record of what rises through the body when silence becomes the teacher. The archive here holds feeling as data: temperature, breath, the weight of being held by the ground you're leaving.

features.name: contact threshold
features.desc-on-touch: A place where bodies learned to negotiate space without speaking. The ascent here is touch — feeling the way through silence, the ground beneath and the air becoming known through the body's knowledge.

features.name: tender documentation
features.desc-on-touch: Text describing what pressure teaches: negotiation, grace, the knowledge that two bodies touching is medicine. Archive filed under somatic practice, under local history, under the intimacy of rising together.

features.name: silence chamber
features.desc-on-touch: Where the ascent stops and listening begins. The silence here is not absence — it's what the rising body learns it was breathing through all along. The only sound is the knowledge of weight becoming time.

inscription: silence begins where pressure learns that weight has also always been time

file.name: Tender_Ascent_Somatic_Archive.mp3
file.note: Field recording of bodies rising through silence. The archive here holds the sound of weight becoming weightlessness, pressure becoming breath. Checksum: emotionally valid / formally unstable.
